items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: We played, and Mr. Grisman, Sam Grisman, Sam Grisman -- this show was -- oh, was a tremendous success.

ctx.x: Yes, that's right. That's right. Well, that's where the -- the Hippodrome is where this girl, Catherine Yarborough, the first Negro opera singer, you know, that -- in later years she changed her name to Katrina Jarbora because she lost her head and missed out. She's around now. I see her all the time.

But what was I telling you? Oh, about "Struttin' Time." We played, and Mr. Grisman, Sam Grisman, Sam Grisman -- this show was -- oh, was a tremendous success. I don't know what happened that the show closed, but we -- but we -- after the George M. Cohan we toured, you know, went around the different theaters.
